name: The Astronaut
note: Polygons in the rest pose (A1) pixels. The Station's style baseline (the owner). Seat 4, drawn facing right and mirrored. The master is the rest pose's OWN head. Every pose but rest a whole-figure frame with its own drawn head. His round helmet stands on the felt by his right hand: part of that forearm's piece at rest and a props box in every frame but `lose_big` (D4), where he rests his forehead on it in the middle.

what.A1: Rest: gloves on the felt, apart, the helmet by his right hand
what.A3: Check: two gloved fingers tap the felt
what.A4: Call: right glove pushes forward along the felt
what.A5: Bet: leans in, right glove pushed well forward
what.B1: All in: both gloves push forward together
what.B2: Show: right glove turns palm up
what.B3: Big win: gloved fists in the air, a huge grin (`win_big`)
what.B6: Glances out of the window at Earth
what.C1: Touches a photograph tucked in his sleeve (decoy for B6)
what.C2: Checks the oxygen gauge on his wrist
what.C3: Rubs a scuff on his helmet (decoy for C2)
what.C4: Floats a token an inch off his palm and catches it
what.C5: Turns to look at you, a kind smile
what.C6: Rolls his shoulders in the stiff suit (a fidget)
what.D1: Talking: a glove raised, palm open
what.D2: Facing a big bet: sitting back, eyebrows up
what.D3: Lost a pot: a rueful half smile
what.D4: Crushing loss: his forehead on his helmet (`lose_big`)
what.D5: Heads up: leaning in on both forearms

rest.what: his right forearm and glove, and the helmet by it
his left forearm, the oxygen gauge and glove
